title: Partnership Manager for Integrated Platforms
description:
About Ant International (Antom) Ant International is a global leader in digital payments and financial technology. Through our Antom brand, we empower merchants worldwide to connect with over one billion consumers via seamless, secure, and innovative payment solutions. We are driven by the mission to use technology to provide inclusive financial services for individuals and small businesses globally.


The Opportunity Are you ready to shape the future of digital commerce? Ant International is looking for a strategic and high-impact Partnership for Integrated Platform to drive our expansion in Brazil. In this role, you will be a key driver of Antom’s growth, identifying prospecting opportunities and building the foundational partnerships that will scale our presence in one of the world’s most exciting fintech markets.


Key Responsibilities: What You’ll Do

  • Partnership Development & Sales Ownership: Work with various types of partners and platforms to actively identify, prospect, develop, and close key partnerships, leading and owning the full sales process.
  • Revenue & Growth: Consistently acquire new partners and drive revenue through efficient partnerships management, ensuring agreements are closed in a timely manner.
  • Market Intelligence & Networking: Stay informed on all relevant industry trends, the competitive landscape, and customer needs, representing the company at various industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with partners and internal teams to manage expectations. Work closely with technical implementation and product teams to deliver solutions based on customer needs.
  • Onboarding & Client Experience: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to ensure clients are on-boarded as quickly as possible while maintaining an excellent client experience.


Who You Are: Required Skills

  • Experience: 8+ years of working inside TOP BR platforms or PSPs managing partnerships.
  • Networking Skills: Strong networking skills with an active network at C-level with international trade merchants within Brazil.
  • Proven Track Record: Success in delivering complex integrated sales and a history of being a relentless new business hunter with an exceptional track record of overachievement.
  • Strategic Thinking: Sharp strategic thinker who can think outside the box and adapt to fast-paced, high-growth, and complex sales cycles.
  • Sales Methodology: Knowledge of consultative/solution sales process and experience with the “Challenger” approach, including buyer profiling and risk assessment.
  • Relationship Management: Strong experience in developing and maintaining global, cultural, and long-term client relationships that sustain results.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency. Mandarin is a strong plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business/Finance.
  • An extensive network across Brazilian financial institutions and major retailers.


Why Join Ant International?

At Ant International, we thrive on innovation and global connectivity. You’ll be joining a team of builders who are redefining how the world pays and does business. If you are a visionary leader with a passion for the fintech revolution, we want to meet you.


Apply today and help us build a more inclusive financial future.

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.


As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.


This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.


Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.


NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.


Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes e problemas funcionais relacionados com os processos de compras, gestão de inventário, avaliação de materiais, e dados mestre.
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.
  • Efetuar configurações e ajustes no módulo SAP MM para atender às necessidades do negócio e corrigir falhas, seguindo as melhores práticas e a governança de TI.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para melhorias ou correções que necessitem de desenvolvimento ABAP, colaborando com a equipa de Nível 3.
  • Participar ativamente nos testes funcionais e integrados de novas configurações, desenvolvimentos e melhorias no SAP MM.
  • Orientar e apoiar Key Users e analistas de Nível 1, partilhando conhecimento e auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas sobre os processos de MM.
  • Manter a documentação dos processos, configurações e soluções atualizada na
  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs para atendimento e solução de chamados.


Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).
  • Conhecimento em processos de MRP e gestão de necessidades de materiais.
  • Familiaridade com a gestão de dados mestre de materiais e fornecedores (Business Partner).
  • Conhecimento da integração do SAP MM com outros módulos SAP (ex: FI, CO, SD, PP, QM).
  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar (ponta a ponta) iniciativas de Ciência de Dados para alocação/abastecimento no varejo, do problema ao impacto em produção.
  • Desenvolver, validar e evoluir em todo ciclo de vida (exploração → deploy → monitoramento) modelos e análises (forecast, propensão, anomalias, clusterização, otimização) para decisões de estoque e demanda.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (modelo + negócio) e garantir monitoramento, logs/observabilidade.
  • Traduzir achados em recomendação acionável e atuar em squad/quarteto multidisciplinar (produto, engenharia, negócio, dados e design).
  • Garantir clareza de premissas e limites das soluções (dados, regras e critérios), com documentação e governança para adoção e manutenção.
  • Mentorar cientistas mais júnior com rigor técnico (revisão de abordagem, boas práticas e desenvolvimento).
  • Manter a documentação dos sistemas/modelos/dados atualizada e relevante, garantindo rastreabilidade e seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, code review e reprodutibilidade.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados aplicada com entregas em produção e impacto mensurável.
  • Domínio de Python e SQL (modelagem, feature engineering, pipelines analíticos), com prática de Git/versionamento e revisão de código (code review) em fluxo colaborativo.
  • Base forte em estatística aplicada (validação, métricas, vieses, experimentação quando aplicável).
  • Capacidade de transformar problema de negócio em solução técnica (trade-offs claros, foco em valor).
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas multiárea com público técnico e não técnico.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo / estoque / alocação / omnichannel .
  • Domínio prático de IA/ML aplicado (da modelagem à operação): forecast , propensão , anomalias , clusterização/segmentação , otimização , recomendação e noções de MLOps/observabilidade, pipelines e ambientes cloud (GCP) .
  • Experiência com GenAI/LLMs para explicabilidade/assistentes (ex.: RAG, agentes, geração de explicações e recomendações com guardrails).
  • Ter construído soluções de decisão e explicação , como:


  • Explicar políticas e movimentações de estoque (por que decidiu X) com feature importance/SHAP e narrativas.
  • Monitoramento + alertas (drift, performance, ruptura/excesso recorrente, mudança de padrão produto×loja, lead time real).
  • Uso de variáveis externas (clima, eventos, datas comerciais, economia) como features/contexto.
  • Segmentação inteligente e priorização produto×loja com base em comportamento real.

title: Automotive Project/Release Manager

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.

criteria with stakeholder

communication

Product & Delivery Execution

Tools & Ways of Working

Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate

Domain & Platform Experience

Tools & Ways of Working

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

description:

Estamos expandindo nossa equipe de vendas e estamos procurando um REPRESENTANTE DE VENDAS EXTERNO motivado no Brasil para ajudar a acelerar o crescimento na sua região designada. Nesta função, você será um parceiro vital para o Gerente de Vendas, com foco na aquisição de novos clientes e na expansão da nossa presença.

3.Familiarizado com o mercado local e disposto a realizar visitas de campo frequentes.

4.Fortes habilidades de comunicação, execução e desenvolvimento de clientes.

6.Domínio do português; inglês básico é um diferencial.

6.Preferencialmente com experiência em materiais de construção, tubulações, produtos industriais ou energias renováveis.

Este é um cargo de vendas baseado em trabalho de campo, onde a maior parte do tempo de trabalho é dedicada a visitar clientes;

Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.


Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

The Methodical Group (TMG) is a global provider of IT services, consulting, and specialized staffing solutions, operating with a systematic and quality-driven approach for over 25 years. Our client, a fast-growing technology company specializing in freight audit and business analytics solutions, is seeking a Solutions Architect to lead the technical delivery and implementation of their platform for new and existing customers.

This role sits within the Operations organization and focuses primarily on client implementation and solution delivery rather than software development . The Solutions Architect will serve as the primary technical lead for customer implementations, translating business requirements into platform configuration, coordinating delivery activities, and ensuring successful deployments.

  • Lead end-to-end customer implementations , including discovery, requirements gathering, configuration, deployment, and post-go-live support, ensuring successful delivery of the platform.

  • Manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously , coordinating internal teams and ensuring project milestones and timelines are met.
  • Utilize SQL and system knowledge to troubleshoot issues, validate data, and support operational analysis during and after implementations.
  • Maintain clear documentation and delivery tracking using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar project management and ticketing systems .
  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders while working collaboratively across departments involved in the implementation lifecycle.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Business, or a related field .
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in solutions architecture, implementation consulting, technical delivery, or similar client-facing technical roles.
  • Experience with software release processes and SDLC .
  • Familiarity with freight rate, freight audit, or logistics technology platforms is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with the Atlassian Suite (Jira, Confluence) is preferred.

title: Assistente de captação de recursos
description:
A Interartis Brasil está com processo seletivo aberto para a contratação de Assessor(a) de Captação de Recursos – Parcerias Corporativas , em regime de Pessoa Jurídica (PJ ).


A oportunidade é destinada a profissionais e empresas com perfil comercial, experiência na venda de projetos incentivados e atuação estratégica junto a empresas patrocinadoras, especialmente nas áreas de cultura , direitos autorais , economia criativa e impacto social .


Envie currículo ou portfólio, bem como a indicação de pretensão de remuneração e condições de pagamento , para


Objetivo da Posição


Atuar na prospecção ativa, abordagem comercial e gestão de relacionamento com empresas, instituições e potenciais investidores sociais, contribuindo para a ampliação das receitas da Interartis Brasil por meio de projetos incentivados (Lei Rouanet e demais mecanismos), parcerias institucionais, prestação de serviços e novos negócios estratégicos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Mapear e qualificar leads, realizando prospecção ativa de empresas, institutos, fundações, associações e potenciais patrocinadores.


  • Conduzir abordagens comerciais, apresentações institucionais e reuniões com prospects.


  • Apoiar a coordenação de captação na construção e gestão do pipeline comercial, acompanhamento de negociações e fechamento de patrocínios.


  • Desenvolver propostas personalizadas e materiais de prospecção em articulação com as áreas técnica e de comunicação.


  • Monitorar editais corporativos e oportunidades relacionadas a investimento social privado, ESG, cultura, direitos autorais e economia criativa.


  • Alimentar e atualizar o CRM com informações estratégicas sobre contatos, reuniões e estágios de negociação.


  • Atuar no relacionamento pós-venda, fortalecendo vínculos institucionais e potencial de renovação de parcerias.


  • Contribuir para a qualificação de leads oriundos de redes sociais, eventos, site institucional e campanhas.


Entregas Esperadas 


  • Ampliação consistente do pipeline de empresas e patrocinadores.


  • Crescimento no número de propostas apresentadas e contratos de patrocínio firmados.


  • Aumento do ticket médio dos projetos corporativos.


  • Organização e atualização contínua dos processos comerciais no CRM.


  • Consolidação de parcerias estratégicas de médio e longo prazo.


Requisitos


  • Formação em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, Gestão Cultural, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas de projetos incentivados (preferencialmente na área cultural).


  • Habilidade comercial, negociação e relacionamento institucional.


  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.


  • Organização, autonomia e foco em resultados.


  • Desejável experiência com ESG, investimento social privado ou patrocínio cultural.


Sobre a Interartis Brasil


A Interartis Brasil é uma associação de gestão coletiva que atua há 20 anos na defesa dos direitos dos intérpretes audiovisuais, reunindo mais de 3 mil associados, como Bel Kutner , Glória Pires e Ary Fontoura . O nosso objetivo é assegurar ao associado o recebimento do direito decorrente da utilização das obras que contenham as suas interpretações, no Brasil (previsto na Lei 9610/98) e no exterior: o direito de intérprete.


Além da administração dos direitos de forma coletiva, a Interartis Brasil também promove atividades de cunho social e educacional em benefício dos associados.


Em 2025, lançamos \"Jornada da Criação: como gerar conteúdo e engajamento nas redes\" , uma formação online e gratuita voltada a artistas, criadores e profissionais da cultura que desejam aprimorar sua presença digital e aprender a usar as redes como aliadas do trabalho artístico. A \"Jornada da Criação\"  conta com patrocínio da Meta , por meio da Lei de Incentivo à Cultura.

title: Analista Sênior de Monitoria de Fornecedores
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e o Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados mundiais nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com uma das maiores carteiras de seguros do mercado, temos sede na Espanha e comercializamos nossos produtos por meio do canal de vendas do Banco Santander no Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.


Na Zurich Santander, trabalhamos todos os dias para que você seja o protagonista de nossa história e tenha o espaço que merece dentro da nossa empresa. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, este é o seu lugar!


Nosso objetivo é oferecer a você as melhores experiências, queremos que se junte a nós para que juntos possamos construir o futuro da Zurich Santander!


Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?

• Garantir que o owner do contrato realize a avaliação contínua da qualidade dos serviços contratados, incluindo prazos, custos, nível de serviço e inovação.

• Apoiar reuniões periódicas de alinhamento entre Zurich Santander e fornecedores estratégicos.

• Elaborar relatórios executivos de performance e risco para suporte à tomada de decisão.

• Identificar oportunidades de inovação e eficiência nos serviços prestados.


Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?

• Formação superior completa (Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Direito ou áreas correlatas).

• Experiência prévia em gestão, monitoramento ou desenvolvimento de fornecedores.

• Vivência com gestão de contratos e análise de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs e SLAs).

• Conhecimento em governança de terceiros e gestão de riscos.

• Capacidade analítica e habilidade para trabalhar com dados e relatórios.

• Experiência na condução de reuniões com stakeholders internos e externos.

• Conhecimento em processos de melhoria contínua.

• Domínio em Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Apps.


Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:

• Experiência no setor de seguros, bancário ou serviços financeiros.

• Vivência com fornecedores críticos e estratégicos.

• Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma ou similares).

• Experiência em gestão de transição e processos de descontinuidade contratual.

• Perfil com forte capacidade de influência, negociação e gestão de conflitos.

• Forte senso de dono e autonomia.

• Capacidade analítica para suportar tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

• Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças.


Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor ?

Na Zurich Santander lhe propomos fazer parte de uma organização comprometida com o contexto atual, trabalhando profissionalmente na transformação da indústria bancária/seguradora, oferecendo-lhe crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.


Contamos com um excelente ambiente de trabalho, uma equipa de profissionais diversificada e internacional, incentivamos a mobilidade dentro dos países onde estamos presentes para que possa continuar a crescer como profissional. Além disso, dispomos de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo e atrativo para os nossos colaboradores.

title: Network Analyst
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!



Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.



We are looking for a Network Analyst , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, onsite , night shift (12x36) , in the city of Londrina-PR.



Key responsibilities/Expectations from the Role:

The Network Analyst is responsible for monitoring, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise network infrastructure to ensure availability, performance, and security across LAN/WAN, WLAN, and SD-WAN. This role collaborates with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot incidents, deliver enhancements, and support projects aligned with business requirements.

• Monitor network health, capacity, and performance; respond to alerts and incidents.

• Perform configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle management of switches, routers, and WLAN controllers.

• Conduct root cause analysis; create and maintain accurate network documentation and diagrams.

• Implement network changes following change control; validate with testing and backout plans.

• Partner with security to maintain segmentation, access controls, and posture management.

• Support projects: site builds, migrations, SD-WAN rollouts, and connectivity to cloud resources.

• Monitor, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure.

• Implement and maintain network security controls and policies.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support network requirements.

• Document network topology, configurations, and changes.

• Participate in network upgrades, expansions, and disaster recovery planning.


Must Have Competencies:

• Fluent or advanced english for conversation.

• Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise switching and routing platforms (Cisco, Juniper, Arista) and network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, Wireshark).

• Experience with wireless technologies (802.11 standards), network access control (802.1X), and VPN.

• Proficiency with change management, incident management, and documentation practices (ITIL).

• Ability to analyze packet captures, performance metrics, and logs to identify root causes/experience with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.

• On-call support capability and strong communication skills for collaborating with operations and vendors.

• Ability to configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, and wireless devices.

• Knowledge of network security principles.


Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Engineering, or related field.

• Equivalent experience and relevant industry certifications may substitute for formal education. (e.g., CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, JNCIA/JNCIP, ITIL Foundation)

Good to Have:

• Knowledge or Understanding of SD-WAN solutions, QoS, and traffic engineering.

• Scripting/automation (Python, Ansible) for configuration management and reporting.

• Experience with cloud networking (Azure/AWS/GCP), load balancers, and NAC (Cisco ISE).

• Understanding of VoIP and unified communications systems.

• Exposure to Zero Trust architectures and network segmentation.

• Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Enterprise, JNCIS-ENT, or equivalent.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Tech Lead Fullstack- Node/React
description:

Proficiência em React (com TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, SASS, Jest) para o frontend e Node.js (com Express, NestJS, GraphQL, APIs REST) para o backend, além de bancos de dados (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), ferramentas de versionamento (Git), CI/CD (Docker, Jenkins/AWS) e soft skills como comunicação e trabalho em equipe, focando em desenvolvimento escalável, testes e boas práticas de engenharia.

title: Viral Video Scout
description:
Turn Your Love of Viral Videos Into Income


Freelance Viral Video Scout (Remote – Global)


Company: Caters Media Group


Payment: Fixed fee per signed video


About Us

Caters Media Group is a leading international multimedia agency specialising in sourcing and licensing compelling video content to major global media outlets. We work with broadcasters, publishers and digital platforms around the world — and we’re always looking for the next viral moment before it hits the mainstream.

Many of our most successful scouts are people who already spend time discovering trending videos online. If you regularly spot viral moments before they explode across the internet, this could be an opportunity to turn that instinct into income.


The Opportunity

We are looking for motivated, self-driven individuals to join our global network of freelance Viral Video Scouts.

Your role will involve identifying compelling real-life videos online and helping us connect with the original creators so the content can be licensed to global media outlets.


Your responsibilities include:

Discover viral, newsworthy or emotionally compelling videos

Identify and verify the original creator of the content

Introduce creators to the opportunity to have their video licensed through Caters Media Group

Build rapport and, where required, speak with creators via phone or video call to explain how licensing works

Help secure signed agreements allowing Caters Media Group to represent the video

You earn a fixed fee for every video you successfully introduce that results in a signed licensing agreement.


No targets.

No fixed hours.

Work from anywhere.

Work when you want.


How It Works

You complete initial training with our team

We teach you what makes video content commercially valuable

We guide you on verifying ownership and introducing creators to the licensing opportunity

After training, you work independently identifying opportunities


You receive a fixed payment for each successfully signed video.


Your earnings depend on both the number of videos you secure and the quality and suitability of those submissions for licensing.


A fixed fee is paid once a creator has signed a licensing agreement with Caters Media Group for a video you introduced, and the video meets our internal quality and editorial guidelines.


All video submissions and creator agreements are subject to verification and approval by Caters Media Group before payment is issued.


This role is offered on an independent freelance basis and does not constitute employment with Caters Media Group.


What We’re Looking For

You don’t need formal qualifications — but you do need:

A sharp eye for viral and newsworthy video content

Confidence communicating with content creators

A strong standard of spoken and written English

The ability to speak with creators via phone or video call to explain licensing opportunities clearly and professionally

Self-motivation and initiative

Good time management


This role is ideal for people who:

Follow trending videos across multiple platforms daily

Enjoy spotting viral moments before they reach mainstream media

Understand the difference between original footage and reposted content

Enjoy identifying compelling real-life stories and moments

Are comfortable communicating with new people

Want flexible earning potential alongside other commitments

Are budding journalists interested in developing their news sense and editorial instincts

Work in journalism, media, or content creation and are looking to generate additional income alongside their existing work

If you regularly spot videos before they reach major news outlets, this role could be a strong fit.


  What This Is (And Isn’t)


✅ Flexible freelance opportunity 

✅ Fixed fee per signed video

✅ Work from anywhere

✅ Initial training provided

✅ No fixed hours

✅ No minimum targets

❌ Not a salaried role

❌ No guaranteed income

❌ Not suited to those uncomfortable speaking with creators directly


Important

Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates who follow the application instructions carefully and complete the example task will be considered.

Applications that do not meet the requirements below may not be reviewed.


Application Requirements

All applications must be submitted in English.

Please include the following:

Attach your CV / Resume in English

Tell us which social media platforms you use most frequently

Explain why you believe you would be good at identifying licensable video content

Example Video Task

Please provide one example of a recent viral video that you believe could generate licensing revenue.

The video must:

Be posted on the social media account of the original video owner (the person who filmed the content)

Have been posted within the last 24 hours

Include a direct link to the video

Along with the link, please include 2–3 sentences explaining why you believe the video has licensing potential.

Ownership Check - In one or two sentences, explain how you have determined that the person posting the video is the original owner of the footage.

To confirm you have read the full application instructions, please include the word “Scout” in the subject line of your application email.

title: Elementor Expert (WordPress Website Builder)
description:
We are looking for a skilled WordPress developer with strong Elementor experience to join our team and build high-performance websites for our marketing agency clients.


This role focuses on executing a proven build process , not designing sites from scratch. You’ll work from established Elementor Pro templates while inserting pre-generated content and images created by our internal AI systems.


If you enjoy working within clear systems and take pride in building clean, fast, and polished websites , this role will be a great fit.



Responsibilities


  • Build 3–4 WordPress websites per week using pre-built Elementor Pro templates
  • Insert AI-generated content into website layouts (all content is provided)
  • Adjust layouts and design elements to tailor each template for the client
  • Generate website visuals using AI image tools based on supplied prompts
  • Create simple design assets when needed using Canva
  • Integrate WooCommerce functionality for ecommerce websites
  • Ensure each website achieves extremely fast page load speeds (under 1 second)
  • Follow documented build processes and workflows precisely



Required Skills & Experience


  • Advanced proficiency with Elementor and Elementor Pro
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress performance optimization
  • Experience configuring WooCommerce within Elementor websites
  • Familiarity with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, OpenAI, etc.)
  • Basic graphic design ability and experience with Canva
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Available during EST business hours
  • Highly organized and comfortable working within defined processes



What This Role Focuses On


This role is about efficiently producing high-quality websites using a repeatable system .


You will not be responsible for writing content or designing full websites from scratch. Our automation tools generate the text and provide prompts for images. Your job is to assemble the site using templates, produce visuals, refine the layout, and ensure the final result is clean, professional, and extremely fast.



Important Note


⚡ Performance is critical.

Every site must achieve full page load speeds under 1 second without relying on caching solutions.


If you do not have strong experience optimizing WordPress for speed, this role will not be a good fit.



What We Provide


  • Managed hosting accounts
  • Elementor Pro licenses
  • AI-generated content for every site
  • Image prompts for generating visuals
  • Detailed documentation and build processes
  • A steady pipeline of website projects


Full-time role

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (±1 hour flexibility)



Who We’re Looking For


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, efficient, and process-driven . You take pride in producing polished work, enjoy following clear systems, and understand how small optimizations can dramatically impact website performance.


You’re comfortable using modern tools like AI image generators, you work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you care about delivering websites that are both visually clean and technically fast .

Oportunidade única de participar da construção do zero de uma área de Controladoria ao lado de uma diretoria experiente.

title: Pessoa engenheira de gestão de ativos
description:
No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.
No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.
Missão do Cargo
Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.
Assegurar a disponibilidade operacional, o cumprimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias, e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem preventiva
e sustentável.
Responsabilidades Principais
Executar e apoiar tecnicamente as inspeções e avaliações de integridade dos equipamentos e dutos, realizando acompanhamento de campo, controle de relatórios e registros
técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis
Acompanhar a execução de reparos e adequações identificadas nas inspeções, verificando a conformidade técnica das intervenções com os códigos de projeto, normas
regulamentadoras e especificações internas.
Realizar análises técnicas de falhas e contribuir em estudos de melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias como RCA, FMEA e RCM, e propondo soluções técnicas que reforcem
a confiabilidade dos ativos
Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos e instruções de trabalho, assegurando alinhamento com os padrões corporativos e oferecendo suporte técnico ao time de manutenção
e inspeção.
Monitorar a condição e a funcionalidade dos dispositivos de proteção mecânica, como válvulas de alívio e sistemas contra sobrepressão, realizando inspeções técnicas e
mantendo atualizada a documentação correspondente.
Dar suporte técnico à gestão de mudanças e à resposta a emergências, participando do desenvolvimento de Mo Cs e colaborando em investigações de falhas e incidentes
envolvendo sistemas pressurizados.
Disseminar boas práticas de confiabilidade e apoiar auditorias técnicas, contribuindo para a formação técnica das equipes, participando de comitês quando solicitado e
promovendo a padronização dos processos de engenharia.
Coletar, analisar e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade e integridade, colaborando com a área corporativa no desenvolvimento de KPIs e estudos estatísticos que
embasem a tomada de decisão técnica.
Requisitos
Formação: Ensino Superior Completo;
Áreas de formação: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica e Materiais;
Desejável: Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA);
Disponibilidade para contrato temporário de 9 meses;
Experiência Técnica: Metodologias de Confiabilidade (RCA, FMEA, RCM), Inspeção e Integridade de Equipamentos Estáticos e Dinâmicos, Gestão de Indicadores e Análise de Dados Técnicos e Elaboração de Procedimentos Técnicos e Apoio a Mo Cs;
Certificações: CREA
Idiomas: Inglês Básico/Avançado;
Soft skills: Engajamento, protagonismo, foco em resultado, iniciativa e assertividade.
Hard skills: Conhecimento/Experiência com NR 13 e Experiência com Inspeção de Caldeiras e vasos de pressão.

Camaçari- BA - Brasil

title: Técnico de comissionamento de subestações
description:
A Quadrante
Ao fazer parte do Grupo você terá a oportunidade de integrar um time jovem, dinâmico e ambicioso. Somos mais de 1000 profissionais empenhados no desenvolvimento das melhores soluções para o cliente e apostamos no crescimento profissional das nossas equipes, através da participação em projetos desafiantes.
O espírito de colaboração está presente no nosso DNA, tanto através da partilha de conhecimentos no dia-a-dia, quanto através de iniciativas que reforçam a comunidade. Acreditamos no potencial de cada um e queremos ajudá-lo a desenvolver as suas capacidades.
Principais Responsabilidades
Executar atividades de comissionamento de subestações MT/AT;
Realizar testes em:

Transformadores de potência e distribuição;
Painéis de proteção, controle e serviços auxiliares;
Relés de proteção (ANSI / IEC);
Sistemas de CC (baterias e carregadores);
Sistemas de aterramento.
Executar testes de:

Relação de transformação, resistência de enrolamento, isolamento;
Injeção secundária e primária;
Lógicas de proteção, intertravamentos e permissivos;

Elaborar e revisar procedimentos, checklists e relatórios de comissionamento;
Interface técnica com cliente, EPC, fabricantes e equipes de obra;
· Gestão de pendências (punch list) e apoio à liberação final do sistema.

Formação técnica em Eletrotécnica, Eletrônica, Automação ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em comissionamento ou montagem elétrica de subestações;
Leitura e interpretação de diagramas unifilares, trifilares e funcionais;
Disponibilidade para trabalho em campo e viagens;
Conhecimento prático em normas e procedimentos de segurança elétrica.
Diferenciais
Experiência em subestações 69 k V e 138 k V;
Vivência com relés SEL, Siemens, ABB, Schneider, GE;
Experiência com SCADA, telecom e integração de sistemas;
Inglês técnico.

title: Consultor de rh
description:
Atuar como uma ponte estratégica entre a área de Recursos Humanos (HRBP) e as unidades de negócio da TQC, garantindo que as práticas de gestão de pessoas impulsionem os resultados organizacionais.
Consultoria Interna: Agir como um consultor para líderes e gestores, oferecendo suporte em tomadas de decisão sobre talentos, cultura e desempenho. Utilizar métricas (turnover, engajamento, absenteísmo) para tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.
Gestão de Talentos e Desempenho: Acompanhar processos de avaliação de desempenho, feedback, planos de carreira e sucessão para alavancar a performance.
Condução dos processos de movimentação e cargos e salários.
Identificar, desenvolver e reter talentos-chave, além de planejar a sucessão para áreas críticas.
Gestão de Mudança: Facilitar processos de reestruturação organizacional e mudanças culturais.
Solução de Problemas: Mediar conflitos e resolver questões complexas de pessoas, unificando as políticas de RH com as necessidades da operação.

Requisitos e habilidades:
Conhecimento em Subsistemas de RH: Amplo entendimento de recrutamento, seleção, benefícios, remuneração, treinamento e Relações Trabalhistas (mesmo sem atuar operacionalmente neles).
Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de ler relatórios, identificar tendências em dados e transformá-los em planos de ação.
Comunicação e Influência: Forte capacidade de comunicação para dialogar com altos executivos, desafiar o status quo e gerenciar conflitos.
Conhecimento do Negócio: Entendimento aprofundado dos processos operacionais da empresa para contextualizar os resultados.

title: Bilingual civil engineer (load analysis: structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company
Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.
Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, Sys Pro, D365 & Salesforce.
One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / Gen AI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.We are seeking a multipleCivil Engineerswith emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.
English language proficiency is mandatory.These are remote roles.This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.ROLES:
1) Civil Engineers(3+ years of experience)
2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE(0-3 years of experience)Executive Summary
Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.Primary Duties
Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leadsExperience level
Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
